help.rides: Every completed ride counts once, in the year it left on the departure terminal's calendar. Planned, running and cancelled rides do not count.
help.km: Kilometres per source: along the road, per ticket, or as the straight line, which understates a coach route by 10–40 %. A ride without a distance stays out and is counted as such, never as 0 km.
help.hours: Only rides with a time at departure and arrival; a date-only ride has no duration. The line below names the sample.
help.night: A ride whose times say it ran overnight: arriving on a later calendar day than it left, after at least six hours — the night-train rule. A missing time is never filled in. In the overview's night account a night that also has a stay or a night train goes there.
help.terminals: Two entries are the same terminal when they lie at most one kilometre apart, or carry the same name and lie at most ten kilometres apart. A "ZOB" in two cities stays two terminals.
help.transfers: Rides of the same booking that continue at the same terminal within four hours are one journey; the wait between them is the change. Rides without a shared booking are never joined.
help.longestReturn: The most days between two visits of the same terminal, across all rides.
help.favourites: Connections ridden at least twice, both directions together. The name opens the most recent ride.
help.newDestinations: A new destination is a terminal a ride reaches for the first time, where no earlier ride had been — the place your logbook starts from is no new destination. Counted in the year of that ride.
help.delays: Only rides with a recorded delay and times. A ride with no recorded delay never counts as on time.
